elements.Page: Root flex container for a GXML document.
elements.Scroll: Native scrolling adapter. Use it around content that can overflow.
elements.Label: Owned text label.
elements.Select: Owned selection control containing Option children.
elements.Option: A Select option; supports selector identity plus text, value, and disabled.
elements.TextInput: Native LineEdit adapter, or TextEdit when multiline is true.
elements.Image: Owned raster or Godot-imported SVG texture control.
elements.Repeat: Repeats one child template for an Array or CascadeItemModel binding, with optional fixed-height virtualization.
elements.Component: Declares a reusable source-level GXML component.
elements.Slot: Declares default or named component content.
elements.Bindings: Declares optional typed bindings for C# generation.
elements.Binding: Declares one named typed binding inside Bindings.

attributes.id: Stable document identity used by selectors, lookup, and reconciliation.
attributes.class: Space-separated GCSS classes, or one exact one-way binding.
attributes.if: Includes this non-root subtree when an exact boolean binding resolves true.
attributes.visible: Visibility literal or exact one-way binding.
attributes.disabled: Disabled-state literal or exact one-way binding.
attributes.tab-index: Focus order: -1 for programmatic focus or a non-negative order.
attributes.autofocus: Requests initial focus for this control.
attributes.focus-trap: Traps focus inside an element backed by a native Godot Container, including Repeat and structural table/scroll elements.
attributes.slot: Named insertion target on component-instance children.
attributes.checked: Checked literal or exact one-way binding for toggle controls.
attributes.selected: Selected Select index/value, exact binding, or generated binding.
attributes.value: Element-specific value, including Slider/Progress values and Option values.
attributes.required: Requires non-empty TextInput content, or marks a component Param required.
attributes.multiline: Uses the native TextEdit adapter for TextInput.
attributes.pattern: Godot regular expression used to validate TextInput.
attributes.error-message: Validation message for invalid TextInput content.
attributes.src: Project-local image resource path, including Godot-imported SVG.
attributes.bind-checked: Two-way Checkbox, RadioButton, or Switch binding.
attributes.items: Exact Array or CascadeItemModel binding consumed by Repeat.
attributes.key: Dot-separated stable key path relative to each repeated item.
attributes.virtual: Enables fixed-height vertical windowing inside a Scroll ancestor.
attributes.item-height: Required positive fixed row height for a virtual Repeat.
attributes.overscan: Non-negative number of virtual rows retained above and below the viewport.
attributes.name: Name of a Component, Param, Slot, Binding, or generated contract.
attributes.namespace: Generated C# namespace or namespace imported by Using.
attributes.get: Getter method supplied by another generated-class partial.
attributes.set: Setter method supplied by another generated-class partial.
attributes.format-text: Named Formatter applied to generated text output.
attributes.parse-text: Named Parser applied to generated writable text input.
attributes.format-checked: Named Formatter applied to generated checked output.
attributes.parse-checked: Named Parser applied to generated writable checked input.
attributes.format-value: Named Formatter applied to generated numeric output.
attributes.parse-value: Named Parser applied to generated writable numeric input.
attributes.format-selected: Named Formatter applied to generated selection output.
attributes.parse-selected: Named Parser applied to generated writable selection input.
attributes.format-disabled: Named Formatter applied to generated disabled output.
attributes.format-visible: Named Formatter applied to generated visibility output.
attributes.format-min: Named Formatter applied to a generated minimum-range output.
attributes.format-max: Named Formatter applied to a generated maximum-range output.
attributes.input: C# input type/name contract for a Formatter or Parser.
attributes.output: C# output type/name contract for a Formatter or Parser.
attributes.on-pressed: Calls an event-context method when the native pressed signal fires.
attributes.on-toggled: Calls an event-context method when the native toggled signal fires.
attributes.on-value-changed: Calls an event-context method when a native value_changed signal fires.
attributes.on-selection-changed: Calls an event-context method when Select selection_changed fires.

display.description: Enables the focused flex layout; only flex is supported.

flex-basis.description: Explicit flex base length or auto.

gap.description: One row/column gap, or two lengths for row then column.

grid-template-columns.description: Grid columns using px, fr, auto/content, or minmax().

grid-template-rows.description: Grid rows using px, fr, auto/content, or minmax().

grid-column.description: One-based grid column with optional / span N.

grid-row.description: One-based grid row with optional / span N.

padding.description: One to four non-negative native pixel lengths.

margin.description: One to four non-negative native pixel lengths.

position.description: Normal relative flow or absolute positioning.

overflow.description: Overflow drawing behavior; hidden aliases clip.

background.description: Solid color or focused two-color linear-gradient().

font-source.description: One project-local imported Godot Font resource; inherited.

fill-color.description: Fill color for Slider and Progress.

transform.description: Focused translate(), rotate(), and scale() transform list.

transform-origin.description: Transform pivot using supported horizontal and vertical keywords.

transition.description: Property and duration shorthand for reconciliation-time transitions.

transition-property.description: Comma-separated supported CascadeStyle properties or all.

atRules.media: Min-width/max-width pixel viewport query; nested blocks intersect enclosing ranges.
